source: Designed room by room for this building from its outline and its program in tools/room_programs, laid out with tools/design_rooms.py, 2026-11-27. All proposed.

elements.name: Mast row
elements.about: Tall masts carrying traffic-radio aerials that talk to craft on approach.

elements.name: Equipment hut
elements.about: Receivers, power units and fibre links for the antennas in this field.

elements.name: Engineers' shelter
elements.about: Shelter with a desk and kit for engineers working in the field.

elements.name: Weather sensors
elements.about: Sensors that measure radiation and debris near the hull.

elements.name: Beacon antennas
elements.about: Transmit the homing signals craft steer by on their way in.

elements.name: Direction-finding ring
elements.about: A ring of small aerials that tells controllers which direction a radio call came from.

elements.name: Dish array
elements.about: Steerable dishes that track craft far out on the approach paths.

elements.name: Cable path
elements.about: Gravel path over the cable trench, used by engineers and the mast crane.
